definitions.explanation: The organizational structure and framework of formal education in a country, including the levels of schooling, years of study, and progression from elementary through higher education.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学校制度|がっこうせいど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧6-3-3-4⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan's school system follows a 6-3-3-4 structure.

examples.japanese: {学校制度|がっこうせいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Debate continues regarding reform of the school system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学校制度|がっこうせいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧や⟦{義務教育|ぎむきょういく}→義務教育：13964_gimukyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年数|ねんすう}→年数：23485_nensuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Comparing school systems across countries reveals differences in enrollment age and years of compulsory education.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (school) + ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (system, institution). Japan's modern {学校制度|がっこうせいど} follows the 6-3-3-4 pattern established after World War II: 6 years of elementary school, 3 years of junior high, 3 years of high school, and 4 years of university.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学校制度|がっこうせいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧: school system reform
- {学校制度|がっこうせいど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review the school system
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学校制度|がっこうせいど}: Japan's school system
- ⟦{義務教育|ぎむきょういく}→義務教育：13964_gimukyouiku⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: compulsory education system

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's 6-3-3-4 system means ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧ (elementary, 6 years), ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧ (junior high, 3 years), ⟦{高等学校|こうとうがっこう}→高等学校：02997_koutougakkou⟧ (high school, 3 years), and ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧ (university, 4 years). Compulsory education covers the first 9 years (elementary + junior high).

RELATED WORDS:
- {教育制度|きょういくせいど}: education system (broader, includes policy and administration)
- ⟦{義務教育|ぎむきょういく}→義務教育：13964_gimukyouiku⟧: compulsory education
- {学制|がくせい}: school system (historical/abbreviated term)
